hero.subhead: Scan the ear canal in seconds. No contact, no mess, no remakes.

akuris.problemText: Traditional audiologist molds require filling the patient's ear with cold, heavy silicone paste, which can be uncomfortable, is prone to physical distortion, and requires shipping physical impressions to manufacturers. This adds delays, environmental waste, and costly remakes. AKuris eliminates this manual bottleneck.

hero.title: Digital optical holography, seeing in 3D with light.

explainer.plain: AKmira's cameras read the 3D shape of a surface using light, the way sonar reads distance using sound, but with photons. No moving parts, no mechanical refocusing, and small enough to fit on a fraction of a fingertip.
explainer.technical: Digital optical holography is an extension of known interference methods like Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT). By capturing phase interference between a reference beam and the backscattered light, our system measures surface topography and subsurface layers (~3 mm) without physical contact, operating at speed and optical resolution limits.
